propositions: review-bot-ops.md runbook lacks the prod instance ID and AWS region needed for operators to initiate SSM sessions without guessing
region value (us-east-1) is defined in terraform but not documented in the operational runbook where it is needed
autodeploy.sh body auto-updates via BOT_PATHS rsync during deploys, but script-only changes require manual hand-deploy because they do not trigger a BOT_PATHS rsync
installer files (install-autodeploy.sh) and systemd unit files are excluded from re-materialization to prevent self-modification races and always require hand-deploy
runbook must include SSM connection command snippets and trace region definition to its terraform source of truth (var.aws_region default + versions.tf backend)
